mandatory_laws_for_every_scored_arm.fold_force_flat: at each outer fold boundary every position is closed at the last fill opportunity of the fold, flat into the next fold, costs charged, fills tagged fold_force_flat
mandatory_laws_for_every_scored_arm.no_lookahead_mutation_law: mutation tests are mandatory: perturbing any bar's future data must not change any past decision, fill or count; a violation is a hard failure of the arm's implementation
mandatory_laws_for_every_scored_arm.no_post_outcome_change: no strategy, mapping, selection or threshold change between bars once outcome data is visible; any change re-runs the whole cell from scratch under a new disclosed attempt
mandatory_laws_for_every_scored_arm.reconciliation_identity: per arm x cell x tier: net = gross - fee - slippage - funding (BTC funding signed; SPY no funding) to <1e-6; fill counts and switch counts reconcile to the ledger
mandatory_laws_for_every_scored_arm.regime_lag: decisions are taken on a COMPLETED regime/exec bar close and filled at the NEXT executable bar open (>=1 executable bar lag; SPY: decision at session close, fill next session open); no same-bar close-to-fill
mandatory_laws_for_every_scored_arm.separate_reporting: regime_switch_count and position_switch_count are reported as separate fields for every arm x cell x tier (turnover freeze law 7)

BUY_AND_HOLD.definition: single long entry (fraction 1.0) at the first executable bar open after the cell warmup, held to the cell's last bar close; one entry + one exit charged; BTC funding signed over the holding period
BUY_AND_HOLD.use: market context metric per cell; reported, never a gate

FLAT.definition: constant FLAT target across the cell
FLAT.use: degenerate reference; a router indistinguishable from FLAT must fail gates, not win

trial_budget.accounting_law: every computed outcome counts against the budget EVEN IF its artifact fails to publish; the denominator is fixed before the scored run; no mid-run stopping on interim numbers
trial_budget.reference_law: FLAT and BUY_AND_HOLD are reported context metrics per cell; they are never scored arms, never gates, and consume no trial budget
trial_budget.seed_law: arm F's 21 seeds are ONE scored arm instance per cell (median-of-21 headline); seeds are not separate trials
trial_budget.zero_cost_law: zero-cost variants are diagnostic computations inside the same trial; they can never support a PASS anywhere
